liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): The accordion gives Iko Iko a Cajun flavor that drives the jam; Jerry started Iko Iko in the wrong key, stopped, and restarted correctly [24][30]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition from China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider was highlighted [20]
- **Aiko Aiko** (1 review): Listener recalls a call about Jerry's energetic performance during this run [20]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The accordion presence during Dark Star was barely audible and sounded good [26]

## The recordings

- **gd90-12-12.sbd.zei.2030.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 4.31/5 by 35 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer criticized the accordion usage during Dark Star as a travesty [21]
- **gd1990-12-12.149736.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1990-12-12.mtx.tobin.87659.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1990-12-12.149544.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 22 songs; 187 min [5]

## Around the show

- Hornsby played the accordion during Iko Iko, which the reviewer found unpleasant [21]
- The reviewer remembers floating out of the show into freshly dusted streets [23]
- Fluffy coating of Rocky Mountain rain was present outside the venue [23]
- The reviewer, then 19, had backstage passes for this run of shows [27]
- A 1990 rehearsal with the Dead and Hornsby is referenced for context [29]
- The reviewer values the recording for the "cool Colorado rain" moment [31]
- Jerry starts Peggy-O before and after Queen Jane Approximately [2]
- Jerry starts Peggy-O before and after Queen Jane Approximately [3]
- The second set is considered one of the finest in 1990 [24]
- The second set was the best string of music witnessed in years [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-12-12.sbd.zei.2030.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> D-> CDR-> EAC> SHN [1]. Also: The reviewer has an audience recording from a taper in Albuquerque, New Mexico; The recording was ripped by John Zei from a D to CDR transfer [1][31]
- **gd1990-12-12.149736.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 14, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]
- **gd1990-12-12.mtx.tobin.87659.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [3]. Also: The source is a Sony TCD-5M cassette master from Todd Evans [3]
- **gd1990-12-12.149544.ultramatrix.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]
